### 4.1 RACI Matrix

_R = Responsible, A = Accountable, C = Consulted, I = Informed_

| Activity | PGM | BDL | PEE | AA | PSA | DEL | EPL | EA |
| -------- | --- | --- | --- | -- | --- | --- | --- | -- |
| Opportunity Assessment | A | R | C | I | R | C | I | I |
| Business Product Roadmap Development | A | R | C | I | C | C | I | I |
| Technical Roadmap Alignment | C | C | R | R | A | R | C | I |
| Concept Development | A | R | C | R | R | C | I | I |
| Solution Architecture | C | I | A | R | R | R | C | I |
| CRB Preparation & Submission | A | R | C | R | R | C | C | I |
| ARB Preparation & Submission | C | I | A | R | R | R | C | I |
| DRB Preparation & Submission | C | I | A | R | R | R | C | I |
| Implementation Planning | A | C | R | R | R | C | I | I |
| Architecture Decision Records | C | I | C | C | A | R | C | I |
| Technical Debt Management | C | I | A | R | R | C | I | I |
| Governance Compliance | C | I | A | R | R | R | C | I |
| Enterprise Rollup Reporting | I | I | C | I | R | C | A | C |
| Technology Stack Decisions | C | I | A | R | R | R | C | I |
| Security & Compliance Review | C | I | A | R | R | R | C | I |
| Performance & Scalability | C | I | A | R | R | C | I | I |

**Role Key:**

- **PGM** = Product General Manager
- **BDL** = Business Development Lead
- **PEE** = Product Engineering Executive
- **AA** = Area Architect
- **PSA** = Product Solution Architect
- **DEL** = Domain EA Leads (Governance, Security, AI, Business, Information, Application, Infrastructure, ITSM Operations EA Leads)
- **EPL** = EA Practice Lead
- **EA** = EA Leadership
